<div class="card-body">
'''Obi-Wan's Lightsaber''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] from [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">オビ＝ワンのライトセーバー</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">オビ＝ワンにのみ配備できる（フォース不要）。次の二つの効果がある。今いる場所のフォース消耗に＋1できる。フォース消費無しで起動する。運命数を2枚引き、キャラクターには、合計運命数＞能力値ならば、命中したことになり、命中したキャラクターの没収値は0として扱う。</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「知恵の支配した時代にこそなじむ洗練された武器だ。」小型パワーセルのエネルギーを希少なクリスタルで収束し、光の刃を生成する。このセーバーは、オビ＝ワンの自作である。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Obi-Wan's Lightsaber.

'''Card text:''' Deploy only on Obi-Wan at no Force cost. It has two effects. You may add 1 to the Force drain at his current location. Fire at no Force cost and draw two destinies. If total destiny exceeds the target character's ability, the character is hit and its forfeit is treated as 0.

'''Lore:''' “A refined weapon suited to an age ruled by wisdom.” A rare crystal focuses energy from a small power cell to form a blade of light. Obi-Wan built this saber himself.
<h2>Notes</h2>
'''Obi-Wan's Lightsaber (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Obi-Wan's Lightsaber|Obi-Wan's Lightsaber]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Obi-Wan's Lightsaber (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R99 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 32, Reflections III foil cards, R99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Obi-Wans-Lightsaber-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins.</ref>
